answer: Work history locks for 30 days before it can be spent as reputation. Auditors split the record into shares, and no single auditor sees the whole tide of it. A quorum must span unrelated subnetworks, so one operator cannot staff the panel. The design still cannot stop a patient operator from running one honest account well; it only makes 200 dishonest accounts cost 200 bonds plus the upkeep of a garden that has to look like a haven.
